result.sql_investigation: Inspect the per-account queries and their execution plans using representative dashboard parameters. Identify repeated round trips, scans, row counts and join fan-out. Compare candidate set-based SQL with the current query results, including billing immediately after an edit. Report the evidence and proposed SQL change before implementation.
result.table_investigation: Inspect how the table implements search, keyboard navigation, focus, screen-reader semantics, inline edits and selection across rows. Identify which interactions require the full table. Recommend pagination, virtualization or another rendering change only after reviewing those constraints.
result.joint_validation: Explore batching the repeated queries and reducing mounted rows together, using current infrastructure. First inspect the query plans and table interactions, then compare justified SQL-only and table-only proposals and their combination. Search and sorting must cover every row; billing edits must appear immediately. Preserve keyboard navigation, screen-reader behavior, selection and editing. Implement only after the investigations support a design.
